_source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/openai -- OpenAI-compatible layer over the native Gemini API, verified 2026-08-07. response_format_policy set conservatively to omit (not verified whether json_object mode is supported by this compat layer) -- recommend a live test call before trusting for real runs; the closed-loop system prompt already instructs the model to return raw JSON regardless. Model IDs for this endpoint are native Gemini names (e.g. gemini-3.1-pro-preview), not OpenRouter-style google/ prefixed slugs.
_usage_note: Native SDK: the OpenAI-compatible shim reports null prompt_tokens_details (anthropic) / completion_tokens=0 with thoughts hidden (google), both of which are billable. Cost via litellm's cache-aware price table.
